prerequisite: Use when a design profile was deleted and re-created: the corridor regions and link codes are intact but the corridor surface cannot be evaluated and rebuild_corridor does not revive it. Run list_profiles first to confirm the design profile exists.
fixture_requirements: A corridor whose baseline profile reference dangles (corridor_stats reports TargetInvocationException for the corridor surface)
A repaired design profile (FG/Layout type) on that alignment
A healthy corridor for comparison (after reattaching, the surface z range should match it)
assertions: In-memory change only: results must be kept with an explicit save_dwg
An explicitly named profile wins; otherwise the same design-profile detection rules as create_profile_view (FG/Layout) pick one automatically
When no matching profile is found, throw and list the profiles that exist on that alignment (never attach the wrong one silently)
When the corridor has no matching baseline (including an alignment filter that matches nothing), throw instead of succeeding quietly
After reattaching, Rebuild runs by default; a Rebuild failure goes to rebuild_error and does not hide the successful attachment
Fixed means: corridor_stats can evaluate general for the corridor surface (z range matches a healthy corridor with the same assembly)
Idempotent: rerunning on a healthy corridor attaches the same design profile and the surface z range is unchanged
